nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Life Sciences
nodes.description: Life Sciences — Grade 12 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Practical and Test

nodes.title: DNA: The Code of Life
nodes.description: DNA location, structure, replication, RNA, genetic code and protein synthesis

nodes.title: DNA location, chromosomes and genes
nodes.description: Location of DNA in the cell, chromosomes, genes and extra-nuclear DNA; discovery of DNA

nodes.title: Structure, role and replication of DNA
nodes.description: Structure of the DNA molecule, its biological role and the process of DNA replication

nodes.title: DNA profiling
nodes.description: Principles and applications of DNA profiling

nodes.title: RNA: types, location and structure
nodes.description: Types of RNA (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA), their locations in the cell and structural features

nodes.title: Genetic code
nodes.description: Nature and properties of the genetic code; codons and anticodons

nodes.title: Protein synthesis: transcription and translation
nodes.description: Process of protein synthesis including transcription (nucleus) and translation (ribosomes)

nodes.title: Meiosis
nodes.description: Chromosome structure, the process of meiosis, its importance, abnormal meiosis and comparison with mitosis

nodes.title: Chromosome structure and terminology
nodes.description: Structure of chromosomes; key terminology: homologous chromosomes, haploid, diploid, chromatid, centromere

nodes.title: Process of meiosis
nodes.description: Stages of meiosis I and meiosis II including crossing over and independent assortment

nodes.title: Importance of meiosis
nodes.description: Role of meiosis in maintaining chromosome number and generating genetic variation

nodes.title: Abnormal meiosis and consequences
nodes.description: Non-disjunction, aneuploidy and resulting genetic disorders (e.g. Down syndrome, Turner syndrome)

nodes.title: Similarities and differences between meiosis and mitosis
nodes.description: Comparison of meiosis and mitosis in terms of purpose, stages, outcomes and genetic results

nodes.title: Reproduction in Vertebrates
nodes.description: Diversity of reproductive strategies in vertebrates

nodes.title: Diversity of reproductive strategies
nodes.description: Comparison of sexual and asexual reproduction; external and internal fertilisation; oviparity, ovoviviparity and viviparity across vertebrate groups

nodes.title: Human Reproduction
nodes.description: Male and female reproductive systems, puberty, gametogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilisation, development and implantation

nodes.title: Male and female reproductive systems
nodes.description: Structure and function of the male and female reproductive systems

nodes.title: Puberty
nodes.description: Hormonal control and physical changes during puberty in males and females

nodes.title: Gametogenesis
nodes.description: Spermatogenesis and oogenesis: formation of gametes via meiosis

nodes.title: Menstrual cycle
nodes.description: Hormonal regulation of the menstrual cycle including FSH, LH, oestrogen and progesterone

nodes.title: Fertilisation
nodes.description: Process of fertilisation including acrosome reaction and prevention of polyspermy

nodes.title: Development from zygote to blastocyst
nodes.description: Early embryonic development: cleavage, morula and blastocyst formation

nodes.title: Implantation, gestation and role of the placenta
nodes.description: Implantation of the blastocyst, gestation period and structure and functions of the placenta

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Practical and June Exam/Controlled Test

nodes.title: Genetics and Inheritance
nodes.description: Concepts of inheritance, monohybrid and dihybrid crosses, sex linkage, blood grouping, pedigree diagrams, mutations and genetic engineering

nodes.title: Concepts of inheritance
nodes.description: Key terminology: allele, genotype, phenotype, dominant, recessive, homozygous, heterozygous, co-dominance, incomplete dominance

nodes.title: Monohybrid crosses and sex determination
nodes.description: Monohybrid crosses using Punnett squares; sex determination in humans (XX/XY system)

nodes.title: Sex-linked inheritance
nodes.description: X-linked traits including haemophilia and colour blindness; sex-influenced traits

nodes.title: Dihybrid crosses
nodes.description: Dihybrid crosses and the law of independent assortment; 9:3:3:1 ratios and deviations

nodes.title: Blood grouping
nodes.description: ABO blood group system (co-dominance and multiple alleles) and Rhesus factor

nodes.title: Genetic lineages and pedigree diagrams
nodes.description: Interpretation and construction of pedigree diagrams to track inheritance across generations

nodes.title: Mutations
nodes.description: Gene and chromosome mutations, causes (mutagens) and consequences

nodes.title: Genetic engineering, paternity testing and genetic links
nodes.description: Principles of genetic engineering; applications in paternity testing and identifying genetic relationships

nodes.title: Responding to the Environment (Humans)
nodes.description: Human nervous system, reflex arc, human eye and human ear

nodes.title: Human nervous system
nodes.description: Central nervous system (brain and spinal cord), peripheral nervous system and autonomic nervous system

nodes.title: Nerve cell structure, reflex arc and disorders
nodes.description: Structure of a neuron; reflex arc; nerve impulse transmission; common nervous system disorders

nodes.title: Human eye
nodes.description: Structure and function of the human eye; accommodation; common eye defects and corrections

nodes.title: Human ear
nodes.description: Structure and function of the human ear; hearing and balance; common ear disorders

nodes.title: Human Endocrine System and Homeostasis
nodes.description: Endocrine and exocrine glands, hormones, negative feedback and homeostatic mechanisms

nodes.title: Endocrine and exocrine glands and hormones
nodes.description: Distinction between endocrine and exocrine glands; major endocrine glands, their hormones and functions

nodes.title: Negative feedback: TSH/thyroxin and thyroid disorders
nodes.description: Negative feedback loop involving TSH and thyroxin; thyroid disorders such as goitre and cretinism

nodes.title: Negative feedback: insulin/glucagon and diabetes mellitus
nodes.description: Regulation of blood glucose by insulin and glucagon; Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes mellitus

nodes.title: Homeostatic mechanisms
nodes.description: Regulation of blood glucose, CO2, water and salt balance (osmoregulation) and thermoregulation

nodes.title: Responding to the Environment (Plants)
nodes.description: Plant hormones, tropisms and plant defence mechanisms

nodes.title: Plant hormones and tropisms
nodes.description: Role of auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid and ethylene; phototropism, gravitropism and thigmotropism

nodes.title: Plant defence mechanisms
nodes.description: Physical and chemical defences in plants against herbivory and disease

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment and Trial Examination

nodes.title: Evolution
nodes.description: Evidence for evolution, theories, speciation, reproductive isolation, human evolution and Out of Africa hypothesis

nodes.title: Introduction to biological evolution
nodes.description: Definitions of biological evolution, hypothesis and theory; distinction between fact, hypothesis and theory

nodes.title: Evidence for evolution and variation
nodes.description: Fossil record, comparative anatomy (homologous and analogous structures), embryology, molecular evidence and biogeography

nodes.title: Lamarckism, Darwinism and punctuated equilibrium
nodes.description: Lamarck's theory of acquired characteristics; Darwin's theory of natural selection; punctuated equilibrium vs gradualism

nodes.title: Artificial selection and speciation
nodes.description: Selective breeding and artificial selection; allopatric and sympatric speciation

nodes.title: Reproductive isolation mechanisms
nodes.description: Pre-zygotic and post-zygotic reproductive isolating mechanisms and their role in speciation

nodes.title: Evolution in present times
nodes.description: Examples of evolution currently observable: antibiotic resistance, pesticide resistance, industrial melanism

nodes.title: Evidence of common ancestors for living hominids including humans
nodes.description: Comparative anatomy and molecular evidence supporting common ancestry of hominids; key hominid fossil species

nodes.title: Out of Africa hypothesis
nodes.description: Molecular and fossil evidence supporting the Out of Africa hypothesis for the origin and dispersal of modern Homo sapiens

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Revision of Term 1 and Term 2 content in preparation for Trial Examination

nodes.title: Trial Examination
nodes.description: Paper 1 (150 marks): Reproduction in vertebrates 8, Human reproduction 41, Responding to environment humans 54, Endocrine/homeostasis 34, Responding plants 13. Paper 2 (150 marks): DNA 27, Meiosis 21, Genetics/inheritance 48, Evolution 54

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Final NSC Examination

nodes.title: Revision
nodes.description: Final revision of all Grade 12 content in preparation for NSC examinations

nodes.title: Study Leave
nodes.description: Dedicated study leave period for learners ahead of final NSC examinations

nodes.title: Final NSC Examination
nodes.description: National Senior Certificate final examinations for Life Sciences Grade 12
